- `b6f34233d788` / generator v2.2.0: repaired controls/validation; built `ranking={holes_then_area,area_then_holes}` with exact canonical default.
- Both support 2–6 demonstrations, 1–4 prefix-stable queries, four distinct stored queries, setting-neutral inputs, and substantive 30×30 stress.
- Per target bounded audit: 16 seeds, 640 legal-prefix requests, 160 distinct inputs, 1,600 public projections, 16 stress checks, 24 protected-Racket evaluations, zero finite rival survivors.
- Official authoring preflight: four source-bound jobs per target (two settings × seeds 0/17), protected Racket, original canonical-label replay, owner acceptance false.
- Causal evidence: protected wrong-intermediate replay for `1b6b40a92e4f`; protected wrong-order replay for `b6f34233d788`; both change the final output.
- Sequential export: 16 one-query views per target; four first-turn checks, 24 private-field invariance checks and zero saved-export findings.
- Final staged tests: 10/10 and 11/11 passed.
- Canonical authority/reference-rule bytes were not changed. The exact canonical programs are retained as each family’s default.
- Remaining limits: finite audits do not prove universal identifiability; owner native qualification/acceptance and training admission are pending.

Both assigned reviewer deliverables are ready for owner review. No reviewer-side blocker remains.

previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (size varies). ONE connected color-2 (red) shape and ONE connected color-3 (green) shape, placed apart. Their normalized forms share at least one cell AND each has at least one unique cell. Rule: normalize each shape to its own bbox and overlay them -- both -> 8, 2-only -> 2, 3-only -> 3. The two shapes, the grid size, and the two positions all vary freely (was two fixed shapes at fixed spots, ~13 distinct).

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The normalized red coordinate set and the clockwise-rotated normalized green coordinate set produced from this input.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Normalize the red and green input footprints independently to their own top-left origins, then rotate the normalized green footprint 90 degrees clockwise inside its input-derived normalized bounding box.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Overlay those two coordinate sets at their shared normalized origin, writing 8 on overlap, 2 on red-only cells, 3 on green-only cells, and 0 elsewhere in the joint bounding box.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The cells colored by B are exactly the coordinates emitted by A. Replacing the clockwise-rotated green intermediate with the unrotated normalized green footprint changes overlap and exclusive cells, and protected Racket therefore produces a different final grid.
